steps.content: You take a step back and shake your head.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I understand your pain. I respect your anger. But I will not be controlled by hatred.
The frenzied shouting cuts off abruptly, leaving a silence so profound that it grips your heart. In the void, the spectral figures fix you with a glare, their eyes burning with cold fury.

steps.speaker: Shane
steps.content: So you stand with her? You would protect one of them against us?!
His voice distorts into a monstrous howl, a signal that sends him and the demonic shadows at his back charging forward in a blind rage, armed with whatever they could seize.
(Red Flash)
Your shackles manage to stop the first wave closing in on you, yet they only serve as intimidation, not a genuine threat.
You cannot bring yourself to attack these people. After the horrors they have endured, what right do you have to judge their rage? Their hatred is a pain you have no right to punish.
But your mercy is a fuel to their fury. More shadows swarm forth, and this time, the weapons they raise glint with a cold, murderous intent.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: No peace! No compromise! Only your death or ours!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: Tear her apart! Rip the hypocrite to shreds! If you're not with us, you're against us!
(Red Flash)
Your shackles were never meant for defense. The flimsy barrier shatters instantly.

You stagger back to Hilda's side, throwing your body in front of hers as a shield. A storm of projectiles rains down—jagged stones, crude clubs, and rusted sickles. You endure the impacts, but it's a futile defense.
You can't... hold them back any longer.
(White Flash)
You brace for the searing pain, eyes wide open, but it never comes. The phantoms pass through you like smoke, their vengeance striking Hilda instead.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Your anger... your pain...
Amidst sprays of blood and inconsolable wailing, her body gradually breaks apart.

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...I accept... it all...

The last of your resolve hardens. Your shackles shatter the constraints with a surge of will, and weapons of solidified Mania slice into you, their touch like white-hot iron. Bright, searing wounds bloom across your body, each one a fresh fire.
Though they are mere illusions, the agony is devastatingly real, buckling your knees and screaming through your nerves.
But it doesn't matter.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you're burdened by regret. I know it's painful. I know a part of you wants nothing more than to die here.
Throwing yourself in front of Hilda, you take the brunt of the attack, your teeth gritted against the impact.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But don't let it consume you. Let me bear this with you. I came back for you, so you can live on!

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: ...Live on...?

steps.speaker: Hilda
steps.content: Do I... deserve to live on?
The moment her eyes meet yours, the howling Mania recedes like a dying tide.
The scorching air cools, soothed by a sudden downpour, and a film of moisture blurs your vision.
